label: Create Content
description: Creates new content of the type the request names, inside the item this request is about. Later steps act on the new content. The type must be one listed here that the item can hold.

nameFrom.label: Name taken from
nameFrom.description: The fields of the request the new content is named after; the first one holding text is used. If there are none, or none holds text, it is named after its type.

namePattern.label: Name pattern
namePattern.description: A pattern (regular expression) that a requested name must match. Left blank, any valid name is allowed.

nameHint.label: Name hint
nameHint.description: What names the pattern allows, in words, for a form to show.

types.label: Type
types.description: The types of content a request may ask for, in the order they are offered.

nodeType.label: Node type
nodeType.description: The type of content created, e.g. "sch:Section".

label.label: Label
label.description: What the type is offered as. Left blank, the node type.

named.label: Named
named.description: Whether a request may ask for a name for content of this type. Left blank, it may.

namePattern.label: Name pattern
namePattern.description: The pattern a name asked for content of this type must match, in place of this step's.

nameHint.label: Name hint
nameHint.description: What names this type's pattern allows, in words, in place of this step's.
